meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能给已经做好的幻灯片、文档、报告、HTML 页面套上统一的配色与字体主题。它有 10 套预设主题,也能按你的描述临时生成新主题。
howto.when: 当你要给做好的幻灯片、文档、报告等成品套主题时触发。它会先展示 theme-showcase.pdf 让你挑选,你确认后再应用;没有合适的也可以生成新主题。

say.text: 把这份幻灯片套上 Ocean Depths 主题。
say.note: 它会先展示主题总览,你确认后再应用。

say.text: 先给我看看有哪些主题可选。
say.note: 会打开 theme-showcase.pdf 供浏览。

say.text: 这些主题都不合适,按“沙漠日落”生成一个新主题。
say.note: 生成后先给你看,确认再套用。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can apply a consistent color-and-font theme to slides, docs, reports, or HTML pages you already made. It ships with 10 preset themes and can also generate a new one on the fly from your description.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a theme applied to a finished deck, doc, or report etc. It first shows theme-showcase.pdf for you to pick, then applies after confirmation; can generate a new theme if none fit.

say_en.text: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this slide deck.
say_en.note: Shows the showcase first, applies after you confirm.

say_en.text: Show me which themes are available first.
None of these fit — generate a new theme from "desert sunset."
say_en.note: Shows the new theme for review, then applies it.
